## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what a user or contributor can now do. Link the issue if relevant.

## Verification

List the relevant automated checks and their results. For product changes, include signed desktop
rebuild, frozen-backend smoke, and launch evidence, or the specific unavailable device/build gate.

## Documentation impact

Name the maintained docs updated for behavior, setup, configuration, architecture, API, or workflow
changes. If there is no documentation impact, briefly explain why.

## Remaining limits

Record known gaps or follow-up issues. Do not include credentials or private student data.

- [ ] Changes are focused and use existing patterns.
- [ ] Behavioral fixes have meaningful regression coverage.
- [ ] Documentation impact and local-link/stale-reference checks were reviewed.
- [ ] Evidence distinguishes implementation, automated tests, and actual release acceptance.
